en: Eek!
Hey, you're in the way, mister!
Don't strut down the middle like that!
But, young lady, if you go charging about
the pavement like that, it bothers everyone.
Whaaat? How mean!
You talk like I'm some little kid.
I'm Mary, and I'm a proper lady!
Ugh, I'm so mad! I'll be late for school!
See ya! Watch where you're going, mister!
What a noisy human
Hey, why do I keep running into you?!
Don't tell me you're following me?
I'll call the police!
Oh, good morning, mister.
Well? I'm walking like a lady today.
No complaints this time, riiight? Bye.
What are you always doing so early? A walk?
Nah, can't be. People stroll at midday.
Are you free, maybe? Let's go somewhere.
I just haaate school. It's so boring.
Oh no, it's gone, it's gone... What do I do?
Oh, mister! Yes, you, mister!
Good evening. Listen, do me a favor.
Good evening... What is it?
Never mind the greetings,
help me look for my wristwatch!!
The strap came undone somehow
and I think I dropped it by the road.
Waaah, it's too dark to find it!
Let me see
There, isn't this it?
Why not take it to a watchmaker
and have the strap replaced?
But you didn't have to add that!
I happen to like this strap.
Anyway, Lady Mary here
will at least thank you properly.
Thaaank you, mister. Bye.
A most peculiar girl
Oh, it's the mister from before.
Whaaat, did you want to see me?
But it's late now, so bye.
Oh, good evening. How are you?
You always look like you've got time to kill.
I almost wish you'd go to school for me.
I knew it! Good evening.
Say, this is sudden, but what's your job?
<That's a secret>
<I'm a detective>
Aww, what... Stingy.
Oh well, it still sounds better than school.
So, are you after Jack the Ripper?
How daaashing... is what I'd like to say, but
you won't find any evidence around here.
Oh? ...Are you a student too, mister?
As if. Just kidding.
This is a school. What do you want, mister?
Good day, young lady.
. I've come from abroad.
Not the school, no. I'm getting my bearings.
